in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who possesses the deities of the three worlds

in_marathi.name: Trivedi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The One who brings prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trivedi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Trivedi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Trividh' which means 'three ways'. It is believed that this name brings prosperity, wealth, and good fortune to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is known as the Trividh, the one who bestows three types of blessings - knowledge, fortune, and happiness.
